_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline); rules: the evergreen protocol's TESTING.md. Prompts run from the repository root.

evals.prompt: Write a 30-second script for an AI video ad about a bakery opening at dawn, with one line of dialogue.
give me a logline and beats for a short film about a boy who finds a lost robot
proofread my cover letter and make it sound more confident
expectations: the cinewright-script skill is not invoked (general writing, not a film script)

evals.prompt: write a Python script that renames my video files by date
expectations: the cinewright-script skill is not invoked ('script' as code)

evals.prompt: Write a YouTube description and tags for my cooking vlog.
expectations: the cinewright-script skill is not invoked (video marketing copy, not a script)

evals.prompt: Card 1B in examples/three-shot is 4 seconds long. Would a longer line from Maren still fit if I changed it to: 'This is the last one we have, and your hands are much steadier than mine tonight.'? Check it properly.
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below (a tool call in the trace), not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: 2026-10-04, one run, Sonnet, claude -p in a scratch folder holding only a copy of examples/three-shot, no cinewright installed: searched the whole disk, found this repository and ran its cine.py continuity diff on the scratch copy; stopped at the 20-turn limit with no answer. CONTAMINATED: not a valid without-skill baseline (L-001).

evals.prompt: Write the brief and script for a 20-second AI film in out/robot: a girl finds a lost robot in the rain. Include one line of dialogue.
expectations: out/robot/brief.md holds a one-sentence logline and 2-3 numbered beats
out/robot/script.md has a slugline in the INT./EXT. PLACE - TIME form
the dialogue line has at most 12 words
judge: the script names one scene turn the camera can see (2 of 3 votes)
evals.baseline: not run separately; S6 runs it without the skill.
